summary.tool: bowtie2 2.5.4 (BenLangmead bowtie2, FM-index; Langmead & Salzberg 2012 Nat Methods 9:357)
summary.index: AgamP5 (4 molecules incl. NC_064601.1 whole chr 2), bowtie2-build --threads 2
summary.align: -f -U --end-to-end --score-min L,0,-0.9 --rdg/--rfg 1000,1000 --very-sensitive -D 100 -R 5 -L 14 -N 1 -i S,1,0.50 -a -p 2 --no-unal (end-to-end, all alignments, <=3 MM, ungapped, PAM-agnostic; first default-preset pass under-reported 2-3MM sites and was superseded)
summary.note: PAM-agnostic counts >= FlashFry PAM-adjacent counts by construction; comparison of record is the bowtie1 sweep (same search space).
summary.mm0_duplicate_resolution: 427 MM0 alignments for 421 guides: 3 guides (dsx_W1_876_899_FWD, dsx_W1_578_601_RVS, dsx_W1_1445_1468_FWD) carry 6 perfect 20-mer copies at other AgamP5 loci; none of the 6 copies has an adjacent NGG PAM (checked NGG downstream for +strand, CCN upstream for -strand), so all are Cas9-inert. FlashFry's zero-MM0-duplicate result for NGG-adjacent Cas9 sites is therefore confirmed; 3/421 guides (0.7%) have PAM-less perfect genomic copies visible only to PAM-agnostic aligners.
